title: On a rank-based Azadkia-Chatterjee correlation coefficient
abstract: Azadkia and Chatterjee (Azadkia and Chatterjee, 2021) recently introduced a graph-based correlation coefficient that has garnered significant attention. The method relies on a nearest neighbor graph (NNG) constructed from the data. While appealing in many respects, NNGs typically lack the desirable property of scale invariance; that is, changing the scales of certain covariates can alter the structure of the graph. This paper addresses this limitation by employing a rank-based NNG proposed by Rosenbaum (2005) and gives necessary theoretical guarantees for the corresponding rank-based Azadkia-Chatterjee correlation coefficient.
